chunks: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, when the month of Ramadan began, would free every captive and give to every petitioner.

key_terms.رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah, referring to the Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.سَائِلٍ: one who asks, a petitioner or beggar
key_terms.شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ: the month of Ramadan, the sacred month of fasting

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم do when the month of Ramadan began?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the practice of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم at the arrival of Ramadan. It highlights that Ramadan was a time of mercy, generosity, and social care, expressed through freeing captives and giving to those who asked.
